U-FIR ANVESHANA (అన్వేషణ)

Investigation, exploration and discovery

Evidence-first AI for Prohibition & Excise case intelligence

AI-Enabled Unified FIR challenge · Andhra Pradesh Prohibition & Excise · Prototype on synthetic data

Case files hold the answers. Finding them is hard

Records in every shape

FIRs, panchanamas, diaries and scans, each station writing in its own way.

Search by hand

Understanding one case means reading file after file.

Repeat offenders hide

One person, many spellings: Ramesh Babu, Rameshbabu, Naiduu.

Paperwork is retyped

Case diaries and chargesheets rebuilt from facts already on file.

The rule of the game: officers must not have to change how they write.

Our answer: an intelligence layer that shows its work

Legacy record

Word, PDF and scans, as written today

Extracted facts

People, vehicles, items, dates and sections, each with its source quote

Cited brief

Every line links to the exact sentence

Explainable links

Look-alike records, with evidence for and against

Reviewed draft

Diary and chargesheet, approved by a supervisor

Audit trail

Every AI output and decision, append-only

Every insight has evidence. Every AI action is reviewable. The officer stays in control.

One case, five moments

Our story (synthetic data): a driver stopped at Anakapalle with 120 bottles of non-duty-paid liquor, and a name that appears in three files, spelled three ways.

1

Upload

Drop in the new FIR, panchanama and diary.

2

Understand

A cited brief, and where the case stands.

3

Connect

The same man, three spellings, one shared vehicle.

4

Draft & decide

Legal suggestions and drafts, approved by a person.

5

Run the case

Custody, deadlines, seizures and a checklist.

1 · Upload anything, exactly as it is written

  • Any formatWord, PDF, text and scanned images (OCR). Up to 20 files at once.
  • It reads for youSuggests the document type, the case and the date, and flags duplicates and unreadable files.
  • It shows the impactThe new FIR links to 3 earlier cases and a shared vehicle, in seconds.

Leads, not findings: a person decides each one, with a reason. Scans and Telugu documents always go to review.

2 · Understand a case in a minute

  • Every line cites its sourceClick a line and the exact sentence highlights in the original FIR.
  • Gaps and conflicts, shownA missing panchanama or two different ages is flagged, not hidden.
  • Where the case standsRegistered, seizure, samples, custody, chargesheet, court.

3 · Find the repeat offender behind the spellings

Search “Rameshbabu”: every spelling is found, and each result says why it matched.

Look-alike records are grouped for review. Nothing merges without a person and a reason.

Two different “Lakshmi Devi” records stay apart: a name alone never links two people.

4 · Law and paperwork, advisory until approved

Suggestions come only from a catalogue, cite the facts, and abstain when unsure. The catalogue here is a demo.

Drafts have placeholders that block submission. A supervisor approves; authors cannot approve their own.

AI-assisted output is never an official record until a person approves it.

5 · Run the case, not just read it

  • Accused and custodyThe officer decides who is an accused; statuses and dates are tracked.
  • Deadlines that nagChargesheet, remand and hearing dates, with overdue warnings.
  • Seizure registerFilled from the records, with sample and lab status.
Deadlines surface everywhere: a briefing bar on every page, the dashboard and a Deadlines page.

Ask in plain words, in English or తెలుగు

The Copilot answers only from records you may see: cited quotes, or an honest “not found”.

One click switches the whole workspace to Telugu. The choice is remembered.

Case content is shown as recorded. Telugu labels were drafted by us and need review by a native speaker.

Trust is built in, not bolted on

One access rule

Role plus district decides what you see in search, graph, Copilot and exports. A restricted case looks exactly like a missing one.

Evidence, not accusations

Records say “named”, never “guilty”. The chargesheet draft leaves who is charged to the officer.

A human decides

Matches, legal suggestions and drafts wait for a reasoned decision. Authors cannot approve their own work.

Everything is audited

An append-only ledger of AI output and decisions. Text hidden in a document cannot give the system orders (tested).

Also: login rate limiting · security headers and CSP · API data never cached · validated uploads · synthetic data only.

84%overall precision and recall on 6 held-out documents (37 facts)

Small, single-annotator, synthetic set: do not extrapolate. Our weak spots are person recall (56%) and place precision (56%). Anything unsure goes to a person, never straight to a record.
